title: PRGB Benchmark: A Robust Placeholder-Assisted Algorithm for Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Zhehao Tan; Yihan Jiao; Dan Yang; Lei Liu; Jie Feng; Duolin Sun; Yue Shen; Jian Wang; Peng Wei; Jinjie Gu
why_relevant: Introduces a fine-grained benchmark evaluating LLM robustness in RAG across multi-level noise filtering, combination, and reasoning, with a placeholder method to decouple parametric vs external knowledge—directly relevant to noisy retrieval and parametric-vs-context conflict evaluation.
why_not_or_caveat: Focuses on benchmarking rather than proposing defenses or calibration methods.
